guard: finite native KV scans delete ONLY their own consumer in finally, clean up after rotation, and refuse incomplete passes with IncompleteKvScan

mutations.name: omits consumer deletion in finally
mutations.find: await oc.delete().catch(() => { /* deletion failure: TTL is the backstop */ });
mutations.expectRed: completed scan deletes ONLY its own consumer in finally
mutations.cell: completed scan deletes ONLY its own consumer in finally

mutations.name: omits completeness check on scan ending
mutations.find: if (!sawTerminal) throw new IncompleteKvScan(bucketName, received, expected);
mutations.expectRed: unfiltered, cut mid-drain: raises IncompleteKvScan, never returns a list
mutations.cell: unfiltered, cut mid-drain: raises IncompleteKvScan, never returns a list

mutations.name: omits rotated consumer deletion in finally
mutations.expectRed: rotation: rotated consumer is deleted in finally (no consumer leaked on broker)
mutations.cell: rotation: rotated consumer is deleted in finally (no consumer leaked on broker)
